product_metadata.title: Baseboard Genie
description: Baseboard Genie - the easy way to clean your baseboards. Simply walk and guide to use. Use it for wet and dry everyday cleaning. Telescopic handle - use up high, or down low. Plush fibers grab dirt and dust. 180° rotation.
